purpose: Canonical registry of reusable blueprints and major data-layer entry points.
blueprint_filename_contract: Every standalone blueprint file uses the pattern <subject>-blueprint.json. Legacy names ending in -master, -system or bare .json are migration targets, not preferred new names.

blueprints.applies_to: canonical country acquisition and normalization
blueprints.migration_note: Legacy root-level location retained for current generators; future replacement should be countries-blueprint.json with producer migration.

automation_rule: Blueprints are executable specifications for acquisition, normalization, relationships, validation and refresh. Missing data remains explicitly missing.
frontend_rule: The frontend consumes generated indexes/manifests rather than discovering arbitrary blueprint files itself.
quality_rule: Prefer fewer high-quality blueprints with distinct entity boundaries and acquisition logic over many shallow near-duplicates.
